A <br> inside a fenced code block stays a real newline, not a split span

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<pre><code>A<br>B</code></pre>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
